scope: Corollary 2.4 of the manuscript “Close Separable C*-Algebras Without Spatial Conjugacy” (preprints/Close-Separable-Cstar-Algebras-Without-Spatial-Conjugacy-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 289 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1ea2edc84a981a7e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the hypotheses of Proposition 2.1, suppose that P has the spatial tensor-norm identity relative to D, whereas Q does not. Then ED(P) and ED(Q) are not spatially conjugate. If W ∈ B(L) is unitary and WPW∗ = Q, then nevertheless dKK(ED(P), ED(Q)) ≤ 2 ∥W − IL∥ .
